name: girth
description: Just-in-time, project-scoped skills distilled from the skills you already have, and a local ledger of what your agent spends.

interface.shortDescription: Distil only the skill slice your project needs
interface.longDescription: Girth finds the installed skills a task needs, distils only that slice into a small project skill, and reuses it in later sessions. girth import and girth advise show what Codex spends and how to cut it.
